mapper.sql: app_user u JOIN web_credential c ON c.user_id = u.id
u.account_kind = 'STAFF' AND (u.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR c.identifier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!') AND (#{status} = '' OR u.status = #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.display_name, c.identifier, u.status FROM WHERE ORDER BY u.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET display_name = #{name}, status = #{status}, session_version = session_version + IF(#{status} = 'INACTIVE', 1, 0), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND account_kind = 'STAFF'
mapper.select: SELECT code FROM auth_role WHERE code = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM app_user u JOIN staff_grant g ON g.staff_id = u.id WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND g.role_code = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' AND AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_grant_permission gp WHERE gp.grant_id = g.id AND gp.permission_code = 'users.write') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_grant_permission gp WHERE gp.grant_id = g.id AND gp.permission_code = 'admins.manage')
mapper.sql: auth_role_permission rp JOIN auth_permission p ON p.code = rp.permission_code
mapper.select: SELECT FROM WHERE rp.role_code = #{role} ORDER BY rp.scope_type, p.code

SELECT rp.role_code, FROM
WHERE rp.role_code IN #{role}
WHERE 1 = 0
ORDER BY rp.role_code, rp.scope_type, p.code

SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS id, CONCAT(sub.name, ' / ', COALESCE(CONVERT(NULLIF(p.application_code, '') USING utf8mb4), '独立报考项目')) AS name FROM exam_project p JOIN exam_subject sub ON sub.id = p.subject_id ORDER BY sub.name, p.id
SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) AS id, CONCAT(s.name, ' · ', site.name) AS name FROM exam_session s JOIN exam_site site ON site.id = s.site_id ORDER BY s.name, s.id
mapper.update: UPDATE staff_grant SET revoked_by = #{actor}, revoked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE staff_id = #{target} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO staff_grant(staff_id, role_code, scope_type, project_id, session_id, granted_by, granted_at) VALUES(#{target}, #{role}, #{scope}, #{project}, #{session}, #{actor}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE granted_by = #{actor}, granted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), revoked_by = NULL, revoked_at = NULL
INSERT INTO staff_grant_permission(grant_id, role_code, scope_type, permission_code) VALUES(#{id}, #{role}, #{scope}, #{permission})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_project WHERE id = #{id}
